name: yolo
description: Yolo: a private, agent-driven media service, with Drive-In as its Tesla client
author: 1MoreBuild

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w clients/tesla && npm run test:unit -w server && npm run test:unit -w service/core -w service/plugin-api -w service/control -w service/node -w plugins/source-plex -w plugins/source-ytdlp && node --test scripts/drive-in-export/*.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration -w clients/tesla && npm run test:integration -w server && npm run test:integration -w service/control
scripts.check:core: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.build: npm run build -w clients/tesla && npm run build -w service/control
